title: EU and Jordan advance strategic partnership backed by €3 billion to boost investment, create jobs and strengthen regional stability
content: European Commission Press release Amman, 19 Nov 2026 Today, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and Commissioner for the Mediterranean Dubravka Šuica took part in the EU-Jordan Investment Conference at the Dead Sea. Alongside His Majesty King Abdullah II bin Al-Hussein, President von der Leyen witnessed the signing of agreements to support Jordan's economic modernisation and resilience.
